string.name: name
string.value: Viral Slime

string.name: desc
string.value: Summons a slime that sprays lethal poison. The slime will stick to an enemy to deal continuous damage. #cIt splits into 2 when the target is eliminated#.

string.name: h
string.value: MP Cost: #mpCon, #dot% continuous damage to the target for #dotTime sec. Slime will last up to #time sec and it will split up to #x slimes\n[Cooldown: #cooltime sec]

string.name: name
string.value: Elemental Adaptation (Fire, Poison)

string.name: desc
string.value: Cover yourself with a veil of fire and poison to defend against critical Abnormal Status at the cost of a portion of Max MP. #cHas a chance to regenerate when successful#. Cooldown only applies when regeneration fails.

string.name: h
string.value: MP Cost: #mpCon, upon defending critical Abnormal Status, consumes up to #x% of Max MP and regenerate the barrier up to #y times at #c#prop% chance#. Cooldown: #cooltime sec\n[Passive Effect: Increases Abnormal Status and all Elemental Resistances by #asrR%]

string.name: name
string.value: Mana Burn

string.name: desc
string.value: When attacking with fire, #cgrants a chance to burn out the enemy's MP to deal extra damage that ignores enemy defenses#. Does not work if the enemy's MP is extremely low.

string.name: h
string.value: Upon casting fire magic, burn #x% of enemy's current MP at #c#prop% chance. #w times of consumed MP will be dealt as extra damage#. If enemy's MP is under #z%, activation will be restricted

string.name: name
string.value: Storm Magic

string.name: desc
string.value: Has a chance to instantly kills monsters with low HP. Damage will increase when you attack enemies under damage over time, stun, freeze, or darkness effects.

string.name: h
string.value: Instantly KO monsters under #x% HP with #y% probability. Damage increased by #z% when attacking monsters under damage over time, stun, freeze, darkness, or paralysis effects.

string.name: hch

string.name: name
string.value: Elemental Adaptation (Ice, Lightning)

string.name: desc
string.value: Forms a barrier of ice and lightning. If you get attacked by critical Abnormal Status, the barrier immediately activates and blocks all Abnormal Statuses for a short time. Also increases all elemental and abnormal status resistances permanently.

string.name: h
string.value: MP Cost: #mpCon, upon defending critical Abnormal Status attack, for #time sec, activates a barrier that blocks all Abnormal Status effects and apply #cooltime sec Cooldown.\n[Passive Effect: Increases All Elemental Resistances and Abnormal Status Resistance by #asrR%]

string.name: desc
string.value: When attacking frozen enemies, you have a chance to ignore a portion of their defenses.

string.name: h
string.value: Attack frozen enemies with a #subProp% chance to ignore #prop% for each stack.

string.value: Mystic Door

string.name: desc

string.name: name
string.value: Holy Magic Shell

string.name: desc
string.value: Fully restores an ally's HP and grants them a holy shield which will absorb up to 10 hits. The shield can last up to 20 seconds, and when it's activated once, it will not be reactivated for a short time even if a different character uses Holy Magic Shell.

string.name: h

string.name: pdesc
string.value: For a set duration, the holy shield will absorb all damage up to 5 times. The shield can be maintained up to 20 seconds, and when it's activated once, it will not be reactivated for a set duration even when a different character uses Holy Magic Shell.\n[Cooldown: 60 sec]

string.value: Holy Fountain

string.name: desc
string.value: Summons the Holy Fountain to recover party member's HP using holy power. Even a party member in Undead status can use it. #cGo near the fountain and press the up arrow key to recover.# Cannot be summoned near a portal.

string.name: name
string.value: Divine Protection

string.name: desc
string.value: Permanently increases Abnormal Status and all Elemental Resistances. When used, you use holy power to create a holy barrier that blocks critical Abnormal Status. Upon casting Dispel, the cooldown is reduced according to the number of recovered party members.

string.name: h
